text:
Free printable Christmas tracing worksheets: 20 words, mug to gingerbread, each with a picture to colour and start dots and arrows. Change the words or add a child's name first. Our own free tool.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/christmas-tracing-worksheets?ref=bsky

Making a word search book for KDP? This makes the whole interior in your browser: 90 themes or your own words, easy to hard, answers at the back. Our own tool: free, $19 once for the cover without the preview mark.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/word-search-book-generator?ref=bsky
#KDP

Type a child's name and print a name tracing worksheet: the name large with start dots and stroke arrows, dotted rows to trace, then lines to write it. Free, no sign-up (our own tool). A class list in one PDF: $19.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/name-tracing?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

KDP gutter margins step up with page count: 0.375 in up to 150 pages, 0.5 in to 300, more beyond. This free calculator gives the gutter, the outside margins and the PDF page size with bleed for your book. No account.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/margin-calculator?ref=bsky
#indieauthor

Free printable Thanksgiving tracing worksheets for preschool and kindergarten: 20 words, each with a picture to colour, start dots and arrows. One PDF, no sign-up, from our own worksheet maker.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/thanksgiving-tracing-worksheets?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

15 CVC words with pictures: write each letter in a box, then trace the word on writing lines. Three pages, US Letter or A4, for kindergarten. Free to print, from our own worksheet maker.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/cvc-worksheets?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

A KDP spine is page count times paper thickness: white 0.002252 in a page, cream 0.0025. This free calculator gives the spine width and the full cover size in inches, mm and pixels, plus a 300 DPI cover template.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/spine-calculator?ref=bsky
#indieauthor #KDP

If you don't add a barcode to your KDP paperback, Amazon prints one on the back cover, so keep that corner clear. KDP's templates reserve 2 x 1.2 inches, lower right, 0.25 in from the trim. Our free template marks it:
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/spine-calculator?ref=bsky
#indieauthor

Dolch sight word flash cards to print: 3x5 cards four to a sheet, or 4x6 two to a sheet. For a matching game, print each word twice with coloured backs. Free PDF, no sign-up, from our kindergarten tools.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/sight-word-flash-cards?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

A Thanksgiving matching game for kindergarten: turn two cards to match a word like pumpkin to its picture. Plays on a phone, tablet or classroom board. Free, no sign-up, our own game.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/sight-word-matching-game?set=thanksgiving&ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

KDP allows paperback spine text from 80 pages. But on a 6x9 cream book, 80 pages fits about 4.5pt type, and KDP asks for at least 7pt on covers. Both rules first fit at 94 pages (104 on white). Free calculator:
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/spine-calculator?ref=bsky
#indieauthor #KDP

Numbers 1 to 10 for kindergarten: count the dots in a ten frame, then trace the number, the first with start dots and arrows. Two pages, US Letter or A4. Free to print, from our own worksheet maker.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/count-and-trace-worksheets?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

Large print word search books for seniors: 8.5 x 11 pages, 14 words a puzzle, letters 18 to 27pt, solutions at the back, print-ready for Amazon KDP. Made in your browser with our own generator. Free to make.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/large-print-word-search-generator?ref=bsky
#KDP

Free printable cursive letter tracing worksheets: 26 pages, A to Z, capital and lowercase cursive on handwriting lines. Or type a name or your own words and print those in joined cursive. Our own free tool.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/cursive-letter-tracing?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

Sudoku books for KDP, graded easy to expert, with 6x6 and 4x4 grids for children. Every puzzle is checked to have exactly one solution, and the answers go at the back. Our own generator, in your browser. Free to make.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/sudoku-book-generator?ref=bsky
#KDP

Free number tracing worksheets, 0 to 9: one page per digit, a numbered start dot and arrows for every stroke, then rows to trace and rows to write alone. One PDF, no sign-up.
https://tracepress.bananafest-destiny.com/number-tracing?ref=bsky
#edusky #homeschool

Crossword books for KDP: 90 themes with 2,346 ready-made clues, or your own words and clues, easy to expert, solutions included, print-ready PDF and cover. Our own generator. Free to make.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/crossword-book-generator?ref=bsky
#selfpublishing #KDP

Maze books for Amazon KDP: perfect mazes from 15x15 to 39x39, one route through each, solutions at the back, print-ready PDF and a cover with the right spine. Our own generator, in your browser. Free to make.
https://puzzlepress.bananafest-destiny.com/maze-book-generator?ref=bsky
#selfpublishing
